tool_args.rationale: The opposing-step signature and measurements show the response depends on the signed before/after contrast, with a nonzero equal-input baseline. The five rows cover multiple horizons and include an equal-input case, supporting numerical fitting of gain, relaxation time, and equilibrium coefficient; no additional probe is justified.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five varied observations include opposing steps, several horizons, and a zero-contrast point; this is enough to identify the three-parameter contrast-plus-equilibrium model without another paid batch.
It is explicitly a nuisance probe and adds no needed discrimination for the observed before/after opposition signature.
Its state-and-horizon form does not account for the sign reversal tied to whether u_now is above or below u_past.
It omits the observed nonzero equal-input response, which the fitted equilibrium term captures.
